## Change

State the problem, resulting behavior and task ID. Include a concrete before/after example when useful.

## Scope

- Task record and allowed paths:
- Branch and commits:
- Contract changes proposed to the integrator (or none):

## Validation

List exact commands, execution location (runner/local), exit codes and meaningful results.
Distinguish mock/scratch tests from live evidence. Include screenshot paths for UI changes.

## Try it

Give reproduction steps using fixtures or a disposable database. Note dependencies, failure modes and remaining blockers.

## Review checks

- [ ] Changes stay within task scope and preserve fixture/GPU-off behavior.
- [ ] No secrets, real personal media, model weights or token-bearing logs are added.
- [ ] No live demo debug/world changes, unauthorized messages or Solana transactions occurred.
- [ ] Required checks ran; unverified behavior is labeled.

Integrator handles contract approval, merge, deployment and publication.
